results.name: Narcos
results.overview: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.

results.name: Narcos: Mexico
results.overview: See the rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in 1980s Mexico.

results.name: Amsterdam Narcos
results.overview: From the 1970s to the 2000s, Amsterdam became the drug capital of Europe. This Sky Original documentary charts how a liberal movement morphed into a violent, billion-pound industry.

results.title: Narcos
results.overview: Three drug traffickers become worried when the realize they may have outlived their usefulness to their boss.

results.title: Yam Narcos
results.overview: An ordinary person living their life gets swept up in the dangerous world of yam trading.

known_for.title: Dope Boys Alphabet
known_for.overview: Noyz Narcos, born Emanuele Frasca, the most important rapper ever to come out of Rome. The author of unforgettable bars and street hits that become gold records. But also the eye behind the camera of hundreds of Mini dv cassettes, published for the first time, with which he documented his artistic career spanning over 20 years.

known_for.title: CVLT
known_for.overview: In the clip for the song "Cvlt" the rappers Salmo and Noyz Narcos go to the master's house. Things take an unexpected turn.

known_for.title: Zeta: Una Storia Hip-Hop
known_for.overview: In a Rome divided between the city center and the suburbs, rich and poor, famous and not, Alex, Gaia, and Marco are three friends in their early twenties who dream of escaping the future society has written for them. Street life, working at the market, poverty, small-time drug dealing, suburban tenements, and the dream of hip-hop are Alex's life until his dream comes true and he finds himself catapulted into the world of rap, playing his part and proving his worth. Managing his own destiny, however, isn't easy, and Alex makes many mistakes, leaving him alone, without a point of reference, and with fleeting success. He must then confront his demons, the harshness of the world, and his own confusion, to learn to love his anger and understand what he truly desires.

results.name: Dublin Narcos
results.overview: Over the 1980s and 1990s Dublin transformed from a recession-blighted backwater to one of the wealthiest cities in Europe. As its fortunes changed so did those of its criminals, who began selling heroin, ecstasy and cocaine. Dublin Narcos tells the story of the rise in addiction, violence and organised crime which persists to this day, with first hand testimony from the kingpins and cops to the ravers and users. We also hear from the fearless journalists whose attempts at exposing the drugs barons led to the death of one of their bravest, Veronica Guerin.

results.title: Narcos Gay
results.overview: Max and Rony have ambitions to become high-class drug traffickers but are drawn into a series of events filled with excess.

results.title: Narcos PR
results.overview: The story of the formation of a police squad (Narcos PR), who must leave their differences behind in order to accomplish a common goal: the capture of a drug network's leader.

results.name: Liverpool Narcos
results.overview: In the 1980s, Liverpool became the epicentre of a drugs boom that was to change Britain forever. With unprecedented access to some of the biggest players, this is the story of how drugs went mainstream and dealing became a multi-billion pound business

results.title: Narcos PQ
results.overview: Documentary about the Mexican cartel in Quebec

results.title: Narcos Alterados
results.overview: This is the story of two powerful drug traffickers who fight for the cartel in the region. One of them, Manuel Salcido, helps the men and women of the town, with the harvest and building the church they so badly need, thus earning the friendship and trust of all. The other Jorge Labastida is a despotic mobster, who at any cost wants to kill Salcido and strip him of his territory.

results.title: Asesinos de narcos
results.overview: A former drug runner plots his revenge against the man who murdered his family.

results.name: Ibiza Narcos
results.overview: Tells the story of how a tiny, sleepy Mediterranean Island was transformed into one the world’s most vibrant party capitals, fuelled by a dangerous and lucrative drugs trade which drew as many criminals to its shores as it did party animals.
